target.title: fix(channels): make nack callbacks idempotent
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Repeated sequential calls to a channel message receive context's `nack()` currently invoke `onNack` more than once. That can duplicate failure handling after a receive pipeline revisits an already-failed stage.

Closes #104903.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add an already-nacked guard in the shared receive context. The guard intentionally still allows the existing ack-to-nack transition and leaves a rejected nack callback retryable, matching the current lifecycle contract.

The focused tests cover duplicate sequential calls and retry after a rejected callback.

## User Impact

Channel receive pipelines no longer repeat completed nack side effects for the same message context. Transient nack callback failures can still be retried.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/channels/message/lifecycle.test.ts` — 17 tests passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/bot-update-tracker.test.ts` — 8 tests passed
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/channels/message/receive.ts src/channels/message/lifecycle.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/channels/message/receive.ts src/channels/message/lifecycle.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Completed sequential `nack()` calls invoked `onNack` repeatedly.

Real environment tested: Node.js v24.15.0 directly imported the production `src/channels/message/receive.ts` module through the repository's `tsx` loader. The temporary runtime harness used two fresh receive contexts and `node:assert/strict`; it did not use Vitest or mocks around `createMessageReceiveContext`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node --import tsx /tmp/openclaw-nack-runtime-proof.mjs` on rebased commit `4583b9c0edb5717f0ff1f08633c3e569702071e7`. The harness called `nack()` twice after a successful callback, then used a separate context whose first callback threw and whose second attempt succeeded.

Evidence after fix:

```json
{"scenario":"completed-sequential-nack","callbackCalls":1,"ackState":"nacked","retainedError":"first failure"}
{"scenario":"rejected-callback-retry","callbackCalls":2,"stateAfterRejection":"pending","finalState":"nacked","retainedError":"retry attempt"}
```

The same rebased commit also passed all 25 focused tests, formatting, lint, and `git diff --check`.

Observed result after fix: A completed nack callback runs once; a callback that rejects leaves the context retryable.

What was not tested: Live channel delivery and the broad remote changed-files gate. No remote lease was created: the available Crabbox configuration had no coordinator authentication and its configured direct provider lacked credentials.
